title: Environment, Hazard, Encounter, Reward, Loot, Economy & World-Content Authoring

selection_basis.reduced_strict_order: MRCS-13 → MRCS-14 → MRCS-16 → MRCS-17 → MRCS-19 → MRCS-21
selection_basis.parallel_lanes: MSAS-21 remains selected_not_started; MVPS-20 remains selected_not_started.

objective: Author environment, hazard, terrain, world-content, encounter, challenge, reward, loot, economy and service definitions with reusable tables and explicit owner references while preserving canonical World placement, encounter execution, and live economy/value authority.
acceptance: environment definitions do not place canonical World state
encounter definitions do not execute encounters
reward/economy definitions do not grant/spend value
boundaries: MRCS-01/03/04/05/08/11/12/13 remain the workspace, guided-authoring, bounded-expression, mechanical-definition and cross-domain package foundations consumed by this tranche.
Environment, hazard, terrain and world-content records remain reusable definitions/packages; canonical World/location placement and live environmental state remain external owner-domain authority.

Encounter and challenge definitions may compose creature, NPC, Action, Effect, Condition, Resource, environment and reward references but cannot instantiate, start, advance or resolve a live encounter.

Reward, loot, economy and service definitions remain reusable references/tables; owned Inventory, grants, currency balances, spending, settlement and other live value state remain external owner-domain authority.
Unknown world, encounter, reward, loot or economy semantics remain unresolved rather than inferred.
MRCS-16+ remain unauthorized until separately selected.
MSAS and MVPS lane state remains independent.
next_action: Establish causal RED for PDCP-MRCS-029 through 031, then implement bounded definition-layer environment/encounter/reward/economy authoring without canonical World placement, encounter execution, or live value grant/spend authority.

last_material_progress.evidence: MRCS-14 started from application main e3bdef17ce2ce497d172479b81c35166af2226bb.
